name: One fixed SBDF2 bridge with startup, transition and wake accuracy
baseline: Six rate128 CPU T16 anchors plus previously frozen rate128 CPU T72 late fields; no changed phase alignment or interpolation.
acceptance: All 21 saved times on three grids for implementation agreement, full-horizon probes, sustained alternating wake, both FD references at all 19 common physical times, and per-cell triangle guards relative to the matching rate128 CPU control. All five fixed RFM seeds and Legendre must pass. The two off-grid bridge instants test implementations only.
scope: Accuracy-only qualification. No timing ranking from concurrently collected solver durations. Fixed switch at t8; failure will not trigger a switch-time search within this protocol. The same weak spatial discretization, boundary forcing and random seeds remain unchanged.
